item.title: Tech30 2026: Meet the 30 startups building India’s next generation of technology
item.description: From spacetech and defence to clean energy, advanced materials, and construction, YourStory's Tech30 spotlights 30 promising startups developing technologies for India and beyond.

item.title: 'I look to China as gurus': Zoho's Sridhar Vembu
item.description: Speaking at TechSparks 2026, Vembu said India has more to learn from China's technology ecosystem than America's, arguing that technology ownership, rather than engineering talent alone, is essential for lasting economic prosperity.

item.title: Pramatra Space is building chip-based quantum security for space and ground networks
item.description: Bengaluru startup Pramatra Space plans to demonstrate its technology in space in 2027, ahead of its first mission in 2028, while exploring applications in telecom, drones, and data centres.

item.title: Priyank Kharge on Karnataka’s plans to drive tech growth beyond Bengaluru
item.description: At TechSparks 2026, Priyank Kharge, Minister for Home Affairs, IT, Biotechnology, and E-Governance, Govt. of Karnataka, highlighted the state’s Beyond Bengaluru policy.

item.title: Cancellation may be a creator’s biggest turning point: Varun Mayya
item.description: At TechSparks 2026, AEOS Founder and CEO Varun Mayya spoke about how online backlash can free creators to speak their minds, why founders need to get comfortable with reinvention, and why there is no secret formula for going viral.

item.title: Agentic video startup Clueso raises $10M in Series A funding round
item.description: The startup founded by IIT Madras alumni plans to use the funding to scale its enterprise go-to-market reach, deepen its agentic layer, and expand editing capabilities.

item.title: TechSparks 2026: meet the innovators exhibiting at India’s premier startup tech summit
item.description: In our photo essay from YourStory's flagship TechSparks 2026 conference, we showcase a range of innovators. Sign up to attend!

item.title: Sridhar Vembu says India must prioritise tech sovereignty over spending billions on GPUs
item.description: Zoho co-founder Sridhar Vembu says India should prioritise infrastructure and foundational technologies over heavy GPU spending to build lasting prosperity and reduce dependence on foreign countries.

item.title: Amansa Investments, SBI Mutual Fund, others invest Rs 413 Cr in Tonbo Imaging ahead of IPO
item.description: Amansa Investments, SBI Mutual Fund and HDFC Life Insurance Company, among others, have invested over Rs 413 crore in defence electronics maker Tonbo Imaging India Ltd through secondary share transactions, valuing the company at around Rs 4,000 crore.

item.title: TechSparks 2026 Day 1: Sridhar Vembu, Priyank Kharge, spacetech founders chart India's 'New Tech Order'
item.description: TechSparks 2026 Day 1: Vembu backs tech ownership over GPUs, Kharge pushes Beyond Bengaluru, and Tech30 2026 is unveiled.

item.title: Hostinger’s Auksė Žirgulė on winning customer experience in the AI era
item.description: Žirgulė highlighted on how AI tools are changing the way businesses are built, customer expectations are changing and how experimentation is now the key to success.

item.title: Srinath Ravichandran and Suyash Singh on overcoming failure in spacetech
item.description: At TechSparks 2026, AgniKul’s Srinath Ravichandran and GalaxEye’s Suyash Singh share how frugal innovation, perseverance through failure, and strategic policy shifts are shaping India’s emerging private space technology sector.

item.title: Meet the 30 startups shaping India’s tech future; Overcoming failures in spacetech
item.description: At the 17th edition of YourStory’s flagship tech-startup event, TechSparks, Sridhar Vembu, Chief Scientist and Co-founder of Zoho Corp, unveiled and presented this year’s Tech30 at TechSparks 2026.

item.title: AI could outperform 90% of coders in six months: Zoho's Sridhar Vembu
item.description: At TechSparks 2026, Zoho’s Sridhar Vembu spoke about why software automation is not nessarily a crisis, urging the nation to focus on technological ownership, hardware foundations, and self-reliance over foreign IP dependency.

item.title: New tech order will be built from Karnataka: Priyank Kharge
item.description: The Karnataka government has initiated numerous programmes to create a talent pool that meets the demands of emerging technologies, said the Minister for Home, IT, BT & E-Governance, Government of Karnataka, at Techsparks 2026.
